headline: Their Forefather Was a Grocer and Mozart’s Most Important Librettist
context: Generations on, Lorenzo Da Ponte’s family keeps alive the memory of this poet and libertine, who ended up in the middle of Pennsylvania after being booted from Venice and Vienna.
